description: Header file defining functions, types, and constants for XDG MIME type resolution, based on the XDG MIME spec. Includes function declarations for MIME type detection, comparison, and management.

methods.name: xdg_mime_get_mime_type_from_file_name
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given filename based on its extension.

methods.name: xdg_mime_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the MIME type resolver, freeing resources.
